entities.name: 2,5-Difluoroacetophenone
observations: SELFIES decode to CC(=O)C1=CC=C(F)C=C1F, an aryl methyl ketone.
The exact ORD record ord-bd08a7390a054eff9ff0fabc3b94e63e uses this ketone as substrate.

entities.name: 1-(2,5-Difluorophenyl)ethanol
observations: SELFIES decode to CC(O)C1=CC=C(F)C=C1F, the corresponding secondary benzylic alcohol.
The transformation preserves the carbon skeleton and aryl fluorines while reducing C=O to C–OH.

entities.name: Ketone reduction to secondary alcohol
observations: The reaction is reduction of an aryl methyl ketone to a secondary benzylic alcohol, not enol-ether formation.
Exact documented precedent: ORD reaction ord-bd08a7390a054eff9ff0fabc3b94e63e.

entities.name: NaBH4 methanol THF reduction
observations: Sodium borohydride is the documented reducing reagent for the exact substrate/product pair.
Methanol and tetrahydrofuran are listed as solvents, with water present in the reaction record for workup or reaction context.
